title: Ancestors, family deity and gratitude
originalScript: ನವರಾತ್ರಿಯ ಆರಂಭ ಸರಿಯಾಗಿ ನೋಡಿ ಕುಲದೇವತೆಯ ಆರಾಧನೆ ಎಂಬುದು ಪಿತೃಗಳ ಆರಾಧನೆ ಮುಗಿದಮೇಲೆ ಕುಲದೇವತೆಯ ಆರಾಧನೆಯನ್ನ ನಾವು ಪ್ರಾರಂಭ ಮಾಡ್ತೀವಿ ಮದುವೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಮುಂಜಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ನಾಂದಿ ಕರೆಯುದು ನೋಡಿದರೆ ಪುಣ್ಯಾಹ ವಾಚನ ಮುಡಿದು ಪಾದ ಪೂಜೆಯನ್ನ ಮಾಡಿ ನಾಂದಿಯನ್ನ ಕರೆಯುದು ನಾಂದಿ ಕರೆದಮೇಲೆ ಕುಲದೇವರನ್ನ ಕೂಡಿಸೋದು ಅಂತ ಇಟ್ಕೊಂಡಿದ್ದೆ ಸೋ ಹಿರಿಯರ ಆಶೀರ್ವಾದ ಪೂರ್ಣ ಆದಮೇಲೆ ಕುಲದೇವರ ಆಶೀರ್ವಾದಕ್ಕೆ ನವರಾತ್ರಿಯನ್ನ ಕೊಂಡಾಡುದು ನವರಾತ್ರಿ ಬುರಿಯ ದುರ್ಗಾಲಕ್ಷ್ಮಿ ಸರಸ್ವತಿ ಪೂಜೆ ಮಾತ್ರ ಅಲ್ಲ ನಮ್ಮ ಕುಲದೇವರು ಏನಿದ್ದಾರೆ ವೆಂಕಟರಮಣ ದೇವರಾಗಿರಲಿ ನರಸಿಂಹ ದೇವರಾಗಿರಲಿ ಒಬ್ಬರಿಗೆ ಒಬ್ಬೊಂದು ದೇವರು ಕುಲದೇವರು ಇರ್ತಾರೆ ಆ ದೇವರನ್ನ ಈ ಒಂಬತ್ತು ದಿನಗಳಲ್ಲಿಯೂ ಪೂಜೆಯನ್ನಾ ಕುಲದೇವತೆಯ ಅನುಗ್ರಹವನ್ನ ಪಡೆಯುವುದು ಮಾಹಾಳ್ಯ ಪಕ್ಷ ಅಂಬುದು ಪಾಸ್ಟ್ ನಮ್ಮ ಪಾಸ್ಟ್ ಏನಿದೆ ಅದನ್ನ ಸರಿ ಮಾಡುವುದು ಅಂತ ಹೇಳುತ್ತವೆ ನಮ್ಮ ಹಿರಿಯರನ್ನ ನೆನಪು ಮಾಡಿಕೊಂಡು ಅವರು ನಮಗೆ ಈ ದೇಹ ಏನು ನಮಗೆ ಬುದ್ಧಿವಿಲಾಸ ನಮಗಏನೊಂದು ಅದ್ಭುತವಾದ ರೂಪ ಲಾವಣ್ಯಗಳನ್ನೆಲ್ಲ ಕೊಟ್ಟದ್ದು ಯಾರು ನಮ್ಮ ಹಿರಿಯರು ಅವರಿಗೆ ಥ್ಯಾಂಕ್ಸ್ ಹೇಳಿದ್ದೇವೆ ಸೋ ಮನಸ್ಸಿನಲ್ಲಿರುವ ಅಂಜಿಕೆ ಏನಿದೆ ಅದನ್ನೆಲ್ಲ ಕೂಡ ನಿವಾರಣೆ ಮಾಡಿಕೊಂಡು ಗ್ರಾಟಿಟ್ಯೂಡ್ ಥೆರಪಿ ಅಂತ ಹೆಸರು ಅದಕ್ಕೆ ಮಹಾಳಯ ನಮ್ಮ ಡಿಎನ್ಎ ನಮ್ಮ ಡಿಎನ್ಎ ವನ್ನ ಎಪಿಕ್ ಜೆನೆಟಿಕ್ಸ್ ಅಂತ ಹೇಳ್ತಾರೆ ಎಪಿಕ್ ಜೆನೆಟಿಕ್ಸ್ ಅವರಿಗೆ ನಾವು ಕೃತಜ್ಞತೆಯನ್ನ ಥ್ಯಾಂಕ್ಸ್ ಅನ್ನ ಹೇಳಿ ಆಸ್ವೀಜ ಮಾಸದಲ್ಲಿ ನವರಾತ್ರಿಯನ್ನ ತೊಡಗುತ್ತೇವೆ

structuredBlocks.english: Look carefully at the beginning of Navarātri. We begin the worship of the family deity after completing the worship of the ancestors. Consider how Nāndi is called at weddings and upanayana ceremonies: after puṇyāha-vācana and worship of the feet, Nāndi is called; after calling Nāndi, the family deity is seated. That is how the sequence has been arranged. So, after receiving the blessings of the elders fully, Navarātri is celebrated to receive the blessings of the family deity. Navarātri is not merely worship of Durgā, Lakṣmī and Sarasvatī. Whatever our family deity is—Veṅkaṭaramaṇa, Narasiṃha or another deity—each family has its own deity. Worship that deity throughout these nine days and obtain the family deity’s grace. Mahālaya Pakṣa concerns the past: it is spoken of as setting our past right. Remember our elders. Who gave us this body, our intellectual capacities, our wonderful appearance and beauty? Our elders. We have thanked them. We remove the fear or anxiety in the mind [GPT reads añjike; native caption hanjike]; this is called gratitude therapy. Mahālaya concerns our DNA, our DNA—he speaks of “epigenetics” [captions say epik jenetiks, repeated]. Expressing gratitude and thanks to them, we begin Navarātri in the month of Āśvayuja.

structuredBlocks.english: Navarātri is a time—how shall we put it?—when the climate changes. Therefore observe the vrata and “detox” the body, as the speaker describes it. In it, the first three days are for Durgā. Durgā, Durgati-nāśinī, she is called: she destroys our sorrows and difficult conditions. Thus the first three days remove the bad; the next three days are worship of Mahālakṣmī, so that good things, wealth and prosperity may grow. The next three are for Sarasvatī. When wealth increases, is wealth alone enough? Should we not also be wise? You have earned money; you should know how to spend it. There should be understanding in that matter. That requires knowledge; for knowledge, Sarasvatī. Yet it is not only celebration of the three goddesses.

structuredBlocks.english: In the next video we are giving the establishment of the uninterrupted lamp and the saṅkalpa to make for it. First, most importantly, a large lamp is needed. It can be earthen or brass. In our home there is a silver one [the following caption phrase about ācārya and silver is unclear]. You may use silver, or gold if there is gold. A good wick, a wick that stands and burns: watch it from time to time and continue adding oil or ghee. It should remain for nine days without a break. What does akhaṇḍa mean? Uninterrupted: it should remain for nine days without a break. You may kindle the lamp with a prayer that our family deity protect us in the form of light. When we receive the family deity’s blessings through the elders, our life becomes Dīpāvali, a row of lamps; it gives happiness. These are the explanations of the festivals the elders have given us.

When these are done, auspiciousness fills the home; the home’s “vibration” is good. Think of Navarātri as putting right, once a year, the changed atmosphere of the home.

structuredBlocks.english: The devatās should come, and all the rākṣasas should go. Who are these rākṣasas? It is not as if some ghosts come and sit in the house. They are the bad qualities within us. Words spoken in the house remain there; their vibration remains there. If people quarrel daily, the vibration of quarrelling stays there. On entering the house, one feels, “Why did I come home?” Or we are [caption haluvutā, apparently speaking of weeping, is uncertain]. Not every day is happiness: one day happiness, one day sorrow, one day weeping [uncertain caption], one day telling our troubles, one day quarrelling or scolding [uncertain wording]. Such an atmosphere is present in the home, is it not? That bad atmosphere itself is the rākṣasas. Let all of them go out and let the divine element give us a sāttvika mind always: that is the intention with which Navarātri is celebrated, he says.

structuredBlocks.english: Prepare fruit, betel leaves and areca nut. In this vrata, there are matters such as a milk-only observance [caption varataka is unclear]; these also occur. Therefore have fruit, betel leaves, areca nut, flowers, gaja-vastra, ghee or sesame oil, turmeric, kuṅkuma, gandha, incense sticks, camphor, betel leaves and areca nut ready. Prepare the lamp properly. Apply turmeric and kuṅkuma, insert the wick, add oil or ghee, and keep it ready. Then we should make the saṅkalpas.

originalScript: ಈ ದೀಪ ಬೆಳಗುವ ಟೈಮು ಮತ್ತು ಕಲಸ ಸ್ಥಾಪನಕ್ಕೆ ಉಂಟಾದ ಟೈಮಿಂಗ್ ಅಂತ ಎಲ್ಲ ಕೇಳಿದ್ರಿ ನಾಳೆ ಭಾನುವಾರ 12 ಗಂಟೆವರೆಗೂ ಏನು ದೊಡ್ಡ ಅಡ್ಡಿ ಇಲ್ಲ ಅಂತ ಹೇಳಬಹುದು ಆದರೆ ನಾವು ಸ್ವಲ್ಪ ನೋಡಬೇಕಲ್ವಾ ನಮಗೆ ಅದರಿಂದ ಸ್ವಲ್ಪ ನೋಡಬೇಕು ಅಂದ್ರೆ ನಾವು ಇದನ್ನ ನೋಡಿ ಇಟ್ಕೋಬಹುದು ಇದನ್ನ ಹೇಗೆ ಅಂದ್ರೆ ಹೋರೆಗಳು ಅಂತ ಹೇಳ್ತಾರೆ ಆ ಹೋರೆಗಳನ್ನ ನೋಡಿದಾಗ ಆ ಟೈಮ್ಗಳು ಚೆನ್ನಾಗಿರುತ್ತವೆ ಅಂತ ಹೇಳಬೇಕು ಅಭಿಜಿತ್ ಮುಗುರ್ತ ಅಂಬುದು 11:45 ರಿಂದ 12 ಒಳಗೆ ಯಾಕಂದ್ರೆ 12 ರಿಂದ ಒಂದುವರೆ ಯಮಗಂಡ ಬರುತ್ತೆ 11 45 ರಿಂದ 12ರಒಳಗೆ ಕಲಸ ಸ್ಥಾಪನವನ್ನ ಮಾಡಲಿಕ್ಕೆ ಸಾಧ್ಯತೆ ಇರುವವರು ಮಾಡಬಹುದು ಇಲ್ಲದಿದ್ದರೆ ಬೆಳಿಗ್ಗೆ ನೋಡಿದೆ ಅಂದ್ರೆ ಬೆಳಿಗ್ಗೆ ಚೆನ್ನಾಗಿ ಇದೆ ಶುಕ್ರ ಹೋರೆ ಮತ್ತು ಬುಧ ಚಂದ್ರ ಹೋರೆಗಳು ಅಂತಏಳು ಕಾಲಿಂದಹವರೆಗೂ ನೀವು ಕಲಸ ಸ್ಥಾಪನೆ ದೀಪ ಸಂಯೋಜನೆ ಇದನ್ನ ನವರಾತ್ರಿ ಕಲಸ ಸ್ಥಾಪನೆ ಮಾಡೋದು ಮತ್ತು ಅಖಂಡ ದೀಪ ಸ್ಥಾಪನೆಯನ್ನ ಮಾಡುವರು ಬೆಳಿಗ್ಗೆಏಳು 15 ರಿಂದ 10ಕಾ ವರೆಗೂ ಅಂತ ಇತ್ತಲ್ರಿ ಈ ಟೈಮ್ ಒಳಗೆ ಸ್ಥಾಪನವನ್ನ ಮಾಡಬಹುದು

structuredBlocks.english: All of you asked about the time for lighting this lamp and establishing the kalaśa [GPT agrees on kalaśa; native ASR repeatedly says kelasa, “work”]. Tomorrow, Sunday, until twelve o’clock, we can say there is no great obstacle. But we should look a little, should we not? So we should check. We can look at what are called horās; looking at those horās, these times are said to be good. Abhijit muhūrta is from 11:45 until twelve, because from twelve to one-thirty Yamaghaṇḍa comes. Those who can establish the kalaśa between 11:45 and twelve may do so. Otherwise, looking at the morning, the morning is good: Śukra horā and Budha and Candra horās. The first captioned morning-time phrase is unclear. You can establish the kalaśa and arrange the lamp, the Navarātri kalaśa establishment and uninterrupted-lamp establishment, in the morning from 7:15 until “hattu kālu,” tentatively 10:15 [both GPT passes have this quarter-hour wording at the final statement, but earlier they give an inconsistent “hattu hattuvare”; listening is needed]. Within that time you may perform the establishment. These are timings for the Sunday referred to in the recording, not automatically timings for a different year or location.
